description: After the agent completes and the worktree has commits, run git push origin <branch>. Detect non-fast-forward rejection by checking for '[rejected]' in git output or exit code. On non-fast-forward: fail the run and report in the status comment — never force-push. On success: return the branch name and pushed commit SHAs to the caller.
title: Push with non-fast-forward detection (no force-push)
